text:
Type: white globe shade table lamp
Use: soft ambient light on a side table, a sideboard or a bedside table; living room, bedroom
Style: Japandi, Scandinavian, minimalist
Materials: textured white woven-look shade, white painted metal stem and round base
Colors: white, soft warm white glow
Shape: wide oval lantern shade with a fine horizontal texture threaded on a slim straight stem, round flat base, tall and light
Feel: soft, calm, airy, serene
Goes with: light wood, linen, white walls, green plants; Japandi, Scandinavian or minimalist rooms

product.name: SOLLEFTE
product.description: You can create a soft, cosy atmosphere in your home with a paper lamp that spreads a diffused and decorative light.
